conservative-field-condition.title: Conservative Field Condition
conservative-field-condition.interpretation: A force field is conservative if its curl vanishes identically, implying the work done is path-independent. This allows the field to be represented as the gradient of a scalar potential.
conservative-field-condition.symmetry_origin: This condition ensures that the work integral around any closed loop is zero. It reflects the irrotational nature of the force field in the 3D spatial manifold.
conservative-field-condition.limits_and_boundary: Violated by magnetic fields (solenoidal) and time-varying fields where the potential itself depends on the history of the system.

omega-effect-differential-rotation-0c3b6.title: The Omega Effect
omega-effect-differential-rotation-0c3b6.interpretation: Quantifies the generation of a toroidal (azimuthal) magnetic field from a poloidal field through the shearing action of differential rotation.
omega-effect-differential-rotation-0c3b6.symmetry_origin: The non-rigid rotation profile of the stellar interior.
omega-effect-differential-rotation-0c3b6.limits_and_boundary: Acts as the primary 'Stretcher' of field lines, amplifying the magnetic energy at the expense of rotational kinetic energy.

bohmian-velocity-vector-field-ident-2dcb.title: Bohmian Velocity Field
bohmian-velocity-vector-field-ident-2dcb.interpretation: Relates the velocity of the k-th particle in a many-body system to the local gradient of the phase S of the wave function in configuration space.
bohmian-velocity-vector-field-ident-2dcb.symmetry_origin: The transition from the Schrödinger equation to the Hamilton-Jacobi form through polar decomposition.
bohmian-velocity-vector-field-ident-2dcb.limits_and_boundary: Ensures that the particle follows a deterministic path that is identically coupled to the global quantum state, selectioning a specific 4D causal topology for the trajectory.
